title: Seed
description: Sets the item as a seed that can be planted to grow crops. When used on valid ground, the seed will place the specified crop block.

crop_result.title: Crop Result
crop_result.description:
The block identifier that will be placed when the seed is planted (e.g., 'wheat', 'beetroot', 'cave_vines').

Sample values:
• beetroot_seeds: beetroot
• glow_berries: cave_vines

plant_at.title: Plant At
plant_at.description:
Array of block identifiers that this seed can be planted on or attached to. If not specified, standard farmland rules apply.

Sample values:
• glow_berries: ["cave_vines","cave_vines_head_with_berries"]

plant_at_any_solid_surface.title: Plant At Any Solid Surface
plant_at_any_solid_surface.description:
[DEPRECATED] If true, the seed can be planted on any solid surface, not just farmland or specified blocks. This property was deprecated and removed in versions after 1.18.

*Introduced in version 1.16.0*

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.19.0*

Sample values:
• glow_berries: true

plant_at_face.title: Plant At Face
plant_at_face.description:
[DEPRECATED] The face of a block where this seed can be planted. Values: 'UP' for top of blocks (normal crops), 'DOWN' for bottom (hanging plants like glow berries). This property was deprecated and removed in versions after 1.18.

*Introduced in version 1.16.0*

*⚠️ Deprecated since 1.19.0*

Sample values:
• glow_berries: DOWN
